items.quote: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
If a soul commit a trespass, and sin through ignorance, in the holy things of the LORD
items.claim: A soul commits trespass and sin through ignorance in the holy things
items.place: in the holy things of the LORD

items.quote: then he shall bring for his trespass unto the LORD a ram without blemish out of the flocks, with thy estimation by shekels of silver, after the shekel of the sanctuary, for a trespass offering
items.claim: The sinner shall bring a ram without blemish to the LORD as a trespass offering, valued in shekels of silver
items.object: a ram without blemish out of the flocks
items.mechanism: with thy estimation by shekels of silver, after the shekel of the sanctuary
